m: aikāgrya n. (fr. ekāgra), intentness or concentration on one object, MBh.; BhP.; Vedāntas.
aikāntika mf(ī)n. (fr. ekānta), absolute, necessary, complete, exclusive, BhP.; Suśr.; Sāṃkhyak. &c.
a: aikāṃtika a. (kī f.) 1 Absolute, complete, perfect; Bg. 14. 27. 2 Assured, certain; Sāṅ. K. 68; Mu. 4. 3 Exclusive. — ke In private, apart from others; Pt. 1.
